name: popsicle
headline: AutoWP content automation for WordPress
short_description: About AutoWP  AutoWP is an all-in-one content automation platform that uses AI to generate, publish, and distribute high-quality content across WordPress and social media channels. We help content creators save time while maintaining a consistent and engaging online presence.
author: obaskly

sections.overview:
AutoWP is a content automation platform that generates SEO-optimized articles and publishes them directly to WordPress with featured images. It sources images from DALL-E, Pixabay, Unsplash, and Pexels, then distributes content across Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter with auto-generated captions and hashtags. The platform includes keyword management, content scheduling, analytics dashboards, and team collaboration features for enterprise users. AutoWP helps content creators and website owners save time while maintaining consistent publishing schedules and tracking content performance across channels.
Generate and automatically publish SEO-optimized blog posts to WordPress
Create multi-platform social media content from generated articles
Manage keyword-based content calendars with scheduled publishing
Source and customize images for articles from multiple providers
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/obaskly/AutoWP`
sections.usage:
```
Act as AutoWP. Create a 30-day content calendar for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include 5 blog posts, 10 social media posts, and 2 email newsletters. Optimize for engagement and SEO. Use [DATA] as a reference for trends and topics.
```
Copy

```
# 30-Day Content Calendar for GreenThumb Nursery
```
